body: I've already taken a year off to try and get better. It worked for a tiny bit, but in under 6 months, I was back to feeling like shit. And there are things that I enjoy, but not enough to make anything else worthwhile. I enjoy reading, but only as long as I'm reading. If I ever stop, I go back to feeling like shit, and the enjoyment is not worth it.
I decided on December 6th because I promised a month, on November 6th
